title: SuperGhidra WriteOverlay Schema v1
description: Schema for SuperGhidra in-memory and on-disk non-destructive symbol/comment overlay files (ghidra_overlay.json).

file.description: Path to target binary or program database

renames.description: Mapping from hexadecimal address key (e.g. '0x00101234') to new symbol name

comments.description: Mapping from hexadecimal address key to comment text

prototypes.description: Mapping from hexadecimal address key to C prototype definition string
